data.exact_reserve_text: Movements arising from prior year claims 40.5 (59.5) (19.0)

prior_year_events.impact_description: Reduction in catastrophe losses from 2017 events contributed to improved claims ratio and favourable prior accident year performance in Marine and Aviation.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 40.5 million in 2018, representing 1.39% of its opening gross reserves. While the Marine and Aviation line of business saw an improvement in prior accident year performance, the overall portfolio experienced adverse development. The report notes a reduction in catastrophe losses in 2018 compared to 2017, which contributed to an improved claims ratio, but does not explicitly link this to the overall prior year reserve movement. An Adverse Development Cover was purchased in December 2018 covering 2018 and prior years' earned business, resulting in a net gain to the income statement.
raw_causal_phrases: improvement to prior accident year performance across a host of classes.
data.data_quality_notes: The exact reserve text for prior year development is taken from a table entry rather than a narrative sentence. The overall prior year development is a strengthening, but the Marine and Aviation LOB is noted to have had an 'improvement to prior accident year performance', indicating a release for that segment. No specific named catastrophe events were identified in the report. There is a significant discrepancy between the explicit prior year movement figure in Note 11a (+40.5m) and the calculated movement from the gross claims development triangle (+175.0m). The explicit figure from Note 11a is used as it is a direct reconciliation item.
